checker_contract: Independent stdlib-only checker takes --capsule --report --output (unique new output file); optionally --check-originals rehashes exact copied original known paths and tree snapshots, never follows external aliases. Recompute exact membership/hash/size/modes/sourcepin222tests, baseline/amendments, report byte copy/hash and exact RESULTS_FINAL filename digest, parent manifest identities, selected XML counts and final-pin classifications, original controls before=after and optional actual originals. Write one unique results file. No builder imports, apps, DB opens, model/native/HTTP/test invocation.

copy_controls_shape.aliases: object keyed by published alias; same alias rows as manifest
copy_controls_shape.files: object keyed by capsule regular member; value {source absolute,before witness,after witness,copy_equals_source:true}
copy_controls_shape.trees: object keyed by evidence name; value {source_root,prefix,before snapshot,after snapshot}

final_runtime_pin_source: Final ready=true INPUTS_FINAL.runtime_pin, after held-source affected checks. Earlier d39 evidence keeps its original pin.

input_config_shape.alias_mappings: EVERY retained alias absolute source->{original_target,target_source absolute-known,authority {path,sha256}|null}; unknown outside-known targets reject
input_config_shape.ready: must be true only after root explicitly finalizes all handoffs
input_config_shape.runtime_pin: final held137-file implementation pin; historical pins remain per-invocation
input_config_shape.source_inventory: object relative->{source absolute,sha256,bytes,kind}; all baseline690 + exact newframe/newtests/operator + baseline007/scopes001+002/amendment metadata
input_config_shape.test_amendments: exact two scope002 endpoint hashes plus preserved originals/patches/scope member; no other old-test change

manifest_shape.aliases: object keyed by every relative symlink; values {original_path,original_target,published_target,target_member,mapping_kind,authority|null}
manifest_shape.directories: list of all actual relative dirs including .
manifest_shape.members: object keyed by every regular relative path except MANIFEST.json; values {sha256,bytes,mode,kind}
manifest_shape.original_frame_extent: MANIFEST ONLY; separately pinned authority scopes/report may be copied

nodeids: XML classname + dot + name, per-case multiplicity preserved

results_shape.counting: no sum across overlapping invocations or different pins
results_shape.limits: facts-only; no pending-aware numerical adoption or scientific completion

tree_snapshot_directories: relative directory map excludes dot; root metadata separate
